sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which natural body at the center of our solar system gives us heat and light?
What is the main raw material used in factories to manufacture paper?
Which of these daily habits is essential for maintaining a healthy lifestyle?
What type of clothes do people mostly wear in hot desert regions to stay cool?
Which simple machine uses a wheel and a rope to easily lift heavy objects like water from a well?
What do we call a specific group of stars that forms a recognizable pattern in the night sky?
Where are large goods like automobiles, airplanes, and washing machines manufactured?
What type of houses are commonly built in regions that receive heavy rainfall and floods?
Which of the following is considered good posture for keeping our spine healthy?
options: C) Bending completely over a desk

questions.question_text: Which part of a bicycle transfers the power from the pedals to the back wheel?
Why do the stars in the night sky look so small even though they are huge? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Stars look very small because they are located millions of miles away from Earth. Their immense distance makes these giant fireballs appear as tiny glowing dots.

questions.question_text: How does a simple lever help us do work more easily? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A simple lever helps us lift or move heavy objects with much less effort by resting on a pivot point and magnifying the pushing force we apply.

questions.question_text: Name two items that are manufactured in large factories and two items made at home. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Televisions and cars are manufactured in large factories using heavy machines. Items like knitted woollen sweaters and mango pickles are usually made at home by hand.

questions.question_text: How does the climate of a place affect the type of food people eat? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Climate decides which crops can grow locally. People in cold coastal areas eat fish to stay warm, while people in warm plains eat mostly locally grown rice and wheat.

questions.question_text: Give two reasons why daily outdoor play is important for a happy and healthy living. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Daily outdoor play makes our muscles and bones strong, keeps our heart healthy, gives us fresh air, and helps us feel energetic and happy throughout the day.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are taking a tour inside a large chocolate factory. Describe the processes you might see happening there. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Inside the factory, I would see giant machines roasting cocoa beans and melting them into thick liquid chocolate. Workers would pour the hot mixture into large molds, cool them on big moving belts, and finally wrap the bars in shiny colorful wrappers.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are an astronaut floating in space and looking down at Earth. Describe what our planet looks like from up there. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Floating in space, I would see Earth looking like a giant, beautiful blue and green marble. The blue oceans, brown and green continents, and swirling white clouds would look amazing against the deep, dark blackness of outer space filled with stars.

questions.question_text: Explain how life in a freezing snowy mountainous region is different from life in a hot, dry desert region. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: In snowy mountains, people wear heavy woollen clothes, live in wooden houses with sloping roofs so snow slides off easily, and eat warm, high-energy foods. In a hot desert, people wear loose cotton clothes to stay cool, live in flat-roofed mud houses to block the heat, and travel using camels.

questions.question_text: Describe step-by-step how a bicycle works when you ride it, mentioning the mechanical parts that help it move forward. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: When you sit on a bicycle and push down on the pedals with your feet, a metal chain connected to the pedals turns the back wheel. This pushing force makes both wheels roll forward on the ground. You then use the handlebars to steer left or right and keep your balance.
